title: Alert Noise Overview
description: Which rules produce the noise, how much, and what kind: frequent, long-lived, flapping, or always on.

panels.title: Total firings
panels.description: Episodes: how many times any alert entered the firing state in the range. Not samples, not notifications.

panels.title: Critical firings per day
panels.description: What the pager would see if routing followed severity. Green under 5, red above 10 (Google SRE: two incidents per 12-hour shift).

targets.expr: ((sum (changes(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", owner=~"$owner"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum (min_over_time(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", owner=~"$owner"}[$__range]) > bool (time() - $__range_s)) or vector(0))) / ($__range_s / 86400)

panels.title: Info share
panels.description: Share of episodes that are report-only. High is fine; it means the info tier is used.

targets.expr: ((sum (changes(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="info", owner=~"$owner"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum (min_over_time(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="info", owner=~"$owner"}[$__range]) > bool (time() - $__range_s)) or vector(0))) / ((sum (changes(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum (min_over_time(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[$__range]) > bool (time() - $__range_s)) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Alerts without owner
panels.description: Distinct rules that fired without an owner label. Routing by team cannot work for these.

panels.title: Alerts without service
panels.description: Distinct rules that fired without a service label. These cannot be mapped to a catalog entry.

panels.title: Distinct rules fired
panels.description: How many different rules produced at least one episode.

panels.title: Firings per hour
panels.description: Log scale: the two series differ by an order of magnitude. Min step 1h so the window equals the step and bars never overlap.

targets.expr: (sum (changes(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", owner=~"$owner"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum (min_over_time(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", owner=~"$owner"}[1h]) > bool (time() - 3600)) or vector(0))
(sum by (severity) (changes(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum by (severity) (min_over_time(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[1h]) > bool (time() - 3600)) or vector(0))

panels.title: Top rules by firings
panels.description: Rules that start most often. Fix: longer for:, wider threshold, or a rate-based condition.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (alertname) (changes(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[$__range])) + sum by (alertname) (min_over_time(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[$__range]) > bool (time() - $__range_s)))

panels.title: Top rules by alert-hours
panels.description: Summed time in the firing state across all series of the rule. Sample count divided by $sph (samples per hour). Fix: repair the cause, or stop calling it an alert.

panels.title: Flapping: mean minutes per episode
panels.description: Alert-hours divided by firings, for rules with more than 3 episodes. Under 5 minutes the alert resolves before anyone can look. QueueDepthHigh is the planted example.

targets.expr: bottomk(15, (sum by (alertname) (count_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", owner=~"$owner"}[$__range])) / $sph * 60) / (sum by (alertname) (changes(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[$__range])) + sum by (alertname) (min_over_time(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{owner=~"$owner"}[$__range]) > bool (time() - $__range_s)) > 3))

panels.title: Always firing: share of range
panels.description: Busiest series of each rule as a fraction of the range. Near 100% means the rule never changes state and carries no information. Delete it or make it a report.

panels.title: Cardinality: series per rule
panels.description: Distinct label sets that fired. Many series with few episodes is one systemic fact spread across instances: fix Alertmanager group_by before touching the rule.

panels.title: Firings by owner
panels.description: Whose rules make the noise. Not a league table; a routing check before a conversation.

panels.title: Severity values in use
panels.description: Every severity value that produced an episode. Anything outside critical / warning / info is a typo in a rule.

targets.expr: count by (alertname, owner, service) (count_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", owner=""}[$__range]) or count_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", service=""}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: OK: every firing rule carries owner and service
